# 错误处理指南

## 错误类型体系

### YueError（交易所层）

位置：`yue/src/errors.rs`

```rust
#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum YueError {
    #[error("Request error: code={code:?}, body={body:?}")]
    ExchangeRequestError { code: u16, body: String },
    
    #[error("Serialization/Deserialization error: {0}")]
    SerdeError(#[from] serde_json::Error),
    
    #[error("error encode: {0}")]
    Ed25519DalekError(#[from] ed25519_dalek::pkcs8::Error),
    
    #[error("Reqwest error: {0}")]
    RequestError(#[from] reqwest::Error),
    
    #[error("IO error: {0}")]
    IoError(#[from] std::io::Error),
    
    #[error("Invalid key length for HMAC: {0}")]
    InvalidKeyLength(#[from] InvalidLength),
    
    #[error("parse data error: {0}")]
    ParseError(String),
    
    #[error("{0}")]
    NotImplemented(String),
    
    #[error("Custom error: {0}")]
    CustomError(String),
}

impl YueError {
    pub fn new(message: &str) -> YueError {
        YueError::CustomError(message.to_string())
    }
}
```

### YuError（应用层）

位置：`yu/src/errors.rs`

```rust
#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum YuError {
    #[error("system io: {0}")]
    SystemIOError(#[from] std::io::Error),
    
    #[error("yue error: {0}")]
    YueError(#[from] yue::errors::YueError),
    
    #[error("duckDB error: {0}")]
    DuckDBError(#[from] duckdb::Error),
    
    #[error("r2d2 error: {0}")]
    R2D2Error(#[from] r2d2::Error),
    
    #[error("li error: {0}")]
    LiError(#[from] LiError),
    
    #[error("Custom error: {0}")]
    CustomError(String),
}

impl YuError {
    pub fn new(message: &str) -> Self {
        YuError::CustomError(message.to_string())
    }
}
```

## 创建自定义错误

### 简单方式

```rust
use yue::errors::YueError;

// 创建自定义错误
return Err(YueError::new("Invalid symbol"));

// 或指定类型
return Err(YueError::ParseError("Failed to parse price".to_string()));
```

### 使用 thiserror 宏

```rust
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum MyError {
    #[error("Symbol not found: {0}")]
    SymbolNotFound(String),
    
    #[error("Invalid price: {0}")]
    InvalidPrice(f64),
    
    #[error("Rate limit exceeded")]
    RateLimitExceeded,
}
```

## 错误传播

### ? 操作符

```rust
async fn fetch_price(symbol: &str) -> Result<f64, YueError> {
    let response = http_client.get(symbol).await?;  // 错误自动传播
    let price = response.price.parse::<f64>()?;     // JSON 解析错误自动转为 YueError
    Ok(price)
}

async fn process() -> Result<(), YuError> {
    let price = fetch_price("BTCUSDT").await?;  // YueError 自动转为 YuError
    println!("Price: {}", price);
    Ok(())
}
```

### map_err（转换错误）

```rust
conn.execute_batch(sql)
    .map_err(|e| YuError::DuckDBError(e))?;

// 或使用 ? 自动转换（如果实现了 From trait）
let count = conn.query_row(sql, []|row| row.get::<_, i64>(0))?;
```

## 最佳实践

### 1. 在底层清晰地报告错误

```rust
// ✓ 好
fn parse_trade(json: &str) -> Result<TradeData, YueError> {
    serde_json::from_str(json)
        .map_err(|e| YueError::ParseError(
            format!("Failed to parse trade JSON: {}", e)
        ))
}

// ✗ 不好
fn parse_trade(json: &str) -> Result<TradeData, YueError> {
    Ok(serde_json::from_str(json)?)  // 吞掉原始错误信息
}
```

### 2. 在中层添加上下文

```rust
async fn fetch_market_data(symbols: Vec<String>) -> Result<Vec<MarketData>, YueError> {
    let mut data = Vec::new();
    for symbol in symbols {
        match fetch_single(&symbol).await {
            Ok(d) => data.push(d),
            Err(e) => {
                error!("Failed to fetch {}: {}", symbol, e);
                // 决定是否继续还是返回错误
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(data)
}
```

### 3. 在顶层处理错误

```rust
#[actix::main]
async fn main() {
    match run_app().await {
        Ok(_) => info!("Application completed successfully"),
        Err(e) => {
            error!("Application error: {:?}", e);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }
}
```

## 常见场景处理

### API 请求错误

```rust
use yue::errors::YueError;

match http_request().await {
    Err(YueError::ExchangeRequestError { code, body }) => {
        match code {
            400 => error!("Bad request: {}", body),
            401 => error!("Unauthorized - check API key"),
            429 => error!("Rate limited"),
            500..=599 => error!("Server error: {}", code),
            _ => error!("Unknown error: {} - {}", code, body),
        }
    }
    Err(e) => error!("Network error: {}", e),
    Ok(data) => println!("Success"),
}
```

### 数据库操作错误

```rust
use yu::errors::YuError;

match db.acquire() {
    Err(e) => {
        error!("Failed to acquire DB connection: {}", e);
        // 选择：重试、降级、或返回错误
    }
    Ok(conn) => {
        // 继续操作
    }
}
```

### WebSocket 连接错误

```rust
use yue::websocket::client::WebSocketEvent;

match event {
    WebSocketEvent::Error(err) => {
        error!("WebSocket error: {}", err);
        // WebSocket 会自动重连
    }
    WebSocketEvent::Disconnected => {
        warn!("WebSocket disconnected, waiting for automatic reconnection");
    }
    _ => {}
}
```

### 解析错误

```rust
pub trait WebSocketHandler {
    fn parse_text(&self, text: &str) -> Result<Self::Output, YueError>;
}

impl WebSocketHandler for BinanceSpotStreamHandler {
    fn parse_text(&self, text: &str) -> Result<Self::Output, YueError> {
        BinanceSpotWebSocketStreamResponse::from_text(text)
            .map_err(|e| {
                error!("Parse error for: {}", text);
                YueError::ParseError(format!("Failed to parse WebSocket message: {}", e))
            })
    }
}
```

## 日志级别对应

```rust
use log::{trace, debug, info, warn, error};

// ERROR: 需要立即处理的严重问题
error!("Database connection failed: {}", e);

// WARN: 可能有问题但可以继续运行
warn!("API rate limited, retrying in 5 seconds");

// INFO: 重要的业务事件
info!("WebSocket connected, subscribing to streams");

// DEBUG: 开发调试信息
debug!("Received {} bytes from WebSocket", data.len());

// TRACE: 非常详细的信息
trace!("Parsing trade message: {}", json);
```

## 重试策略

### 使用 backon 库

```rust
use backon::{Backoff, Retryable};

let result = (async {
    execute_request().await
})
.retry(
    Backoff::builder()
        .with_max_retries(3)
        .with_delay(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100))
        .build_exponential()
)
.await?;
```

### 手动重试

```rust
async fn fetch_with_retry(
    symbol: &str,
    max_retries: u32,
) -> Result<Data, YueError> {
    for attempt in 1..=max_retries {
        match fetch_market_data(symbol).await {
            Ok(data) => return Ok(data),
            Err(e) if attempt < max_retries => {
                warn!("Attempt {} failed: {}, retrying...", attempt, e);
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(2u64.pow(attempt))).await;
            }
            Err(e) => return Err(e),
        }
    }
    unreachable!()
}
```

## 测试错误处理

```rust
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    
    #[test]
    fn test_parse_error() {
        let result = parse_trade("invalid json");
        assert!(matches!(result, Err(YueError::ParseError(_))));
    }
    
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_network_error() {
        let result = fetch_with_bad_url().await;
        assert!(matches!(result, Err(YueError::RequestError(_))));
    }
    
    #[test]
    fn test_custom_error() {
        let error = YueError::new("Custom message");
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("Custom message"));
    }
}
```

## 用户友好的错误消息

```rust
fn user_friendly_message(error: &YueError) -> String {
    match error {
        YueError::ExchangeRequestError { code, .. } => {
            match code {
                400 => "请求参数错误，请检查输入".to_string(),
                401 => "API密钥无效，请检查配置".to_string(),
                429 => "请求过于频繁，请稍后再试".to_string(),
                500 => "交易所服务器错误，请稍后重试".to_string(),
                _ => "交易所返回错误，请查看日志".to_string(),
            }
        }
        YueError::RequestError(_) => {
            "网络连接失败，请检查网络".to_string()
        }
        YueError::ParseError(_) => {
            "数据解析失败，可能是数据格式不兼容".to_string()
        }
        _ => error.to_string(),
    }
}
```
